headline: How to Get Veilfloat
title: How to Get Veilfloat in Aniimo | Evolve Bulbly at Level 42 | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Veilfloat is a Lightning support that evolves from Bulbly, found on Tideblossom Coast in Breezy Plains. Raise Bulbly to level forty two and it evolves into Veilfloat with no extra requirement. Want to go further? Veilfloat becomes Luminelle at level fifty two, after you defeat the Alpha Luminelle and use one Roar Stone. Which one do you want? Comment below!
description: Veilfloat in Aniimo evolves from Bulbly at level 42, and Veilfloat becomes Luminelle at level 52 after defeating the Alpha Luminelle and using a Roar Stone.
